story: A proper escape from Vienna with roads worth waking up for. A 694 km loop that starts and ends near Drassburg, about 14 h 28 of riding. The stops in between: Vrbové and Breitenfurt bei Wien. The climb of the day is Hohe Wand and Puchberg. It tops out at about 850 m. It crosses from Austria into Slovakia - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line. The plan has 1 food stop and 1 fuel stop marked.

scenicChapters.title: Czech South Moravian Wine Route
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 51 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.

slogan: A 285 km loop out of Wachau Danube and Jauerling
story: A proper escape from Vienna with roads worth waking up for. 972 km round from Vienna - plan on about 17 h 40 of riding. It goes by way of Moravské Budějovice, Zruč nad Sázavou, Mělník and Wachau. It crosses Austria, Czechia and Germany - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line. The plan has 1 fuel stop marked.
